name: Knowledge Work Plugins
tagline: Anthropic's official plugins for Claude Cowork - ready-made assistants for sales, support, legal, finance, marketing and more.
sentence: Install one of Anthropic's 11 plugins and your Claude Cowork workspace gets a specialized assistant - for drafting contracts, writing sales emails, analyzing data or managing projects.

board.say: You use Claude Cowork at work but the general assistant doesn't know your role's specific workflows - the right email format for sales, the right clause language for legal, the right metrics for marketing.
board.eg: You need to draft a sales follow-up email that matches your company's tone, but the general assistant gives you generic templates.

board.say: You install a plugin for your role in Claude Cowork.
board.eg: Install the Sales plugin and your workspace gets specialized prompts, templates and workflows for sales outreach, follow-ups and pipeline management.

board.say: Your work context - documents, emails, data, conversations - fed through the plugin's specialized prompts.
board.eg: Drop in a prospect's LinkedIn profile and the Sales plugin drafts a personalized outreach email with the right structure and tone.

board.say: The plugin adds specialized workflows, prompts and templates to your Claude Cowork workspace.
steps: Choose from 11 plugins: productivity, sales, support, project management, marketing, legal, finance, data analysis, enterprise search, bio research, or plugin management
The plugin loads role-specific prompts, templates and workflows into your Cowork workspace
You use the specialized assistant for your role's tasks - drafting, analyzing, managing, reviewing
board.eg: The Legal plugin: paste a contract and get a clause-by-clause review with risk flags, or draft a new contract from a template.

board.say: A Claude Cowork workspace tuned for your specific role.

outputs.eg: A sales email, a legal review, a marketing brief, or a financial analysis - in your role's standard format
A step-by-step pipeline for your role: prospect research for sales, contract review for legal, campaign analysis for marketing

before: The general Claude assistant doesn't know your role's specific format, structure or workflow. You spend time prompting it to match your needs.
Building a custom assistant for your role means writing and maintaining your own prompts and templates.
after: Install a plugin and your Claude Cowork workspace knows your role - the right formats, structures and workflows for sales, legal, finance or whatever you do.
Anthropic maintains the plugins. Updates and improvements come automatically.
uses_note: Knowledge Work Plugins is by Anthropic and has 28K stars. As an official Anthropic project, adoption is primarily through Claude Cowork, where usage is not publicly tracked by individual.

pulse.gain: +2K stars this week, +3.5K in 30 days. 28K total over 9 months.

steps: [Browse the 11 plugins](https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins) and pick the one that matches your role (sales, legal, finance, marketing, support, etc.).
Install the plugin in your Claude Cowork workspace following the README's instructions.
Try a task specific to your role: draft a sales email, review a contract, or analyze a dataset. Compare the result to what the general assistant gives you.

alternatives.line: Engineering-focused skills for Claude Code. Different product (Code, not Cowork) and audience (developers, not business roles).

watch: **By Anthropic, for Claude Cowork.** These are official plugins from the company that makes Claude. That means strong maintenance but also a single-vendor dependency.
**Cowork only, not Claude Code.** If you use Claude Code (the terminal tool), these plugins don't apply. They are for the Cowork collaboration workspace.
**11 plugins, varying depth.** Some roles (sales, support) have deeper workflows than others. Check the plugin for your role before expecting full coverage.
**Apache-2.0 license.** Open source, so you can read, fork and adapt the plugins to your company's needs.
